transcript.text: my oven fan keeps going after ive turned the oven off, been about 20 mins now. is it broken??

Probably not. A fan still running 20 minutes after switching off is usually normal, and it would only point to a fault if it never stops even once the oven has gone cold. This sounds like normal behaviour rather than a fault: Cooling fans keep running after an oven (or a combination microwave) is switched off until the inside has cooled, often 10-30 minutes. It would be worth a closer look if the fan never stops even when the oven is cold. Next: Work out which fan: cavity fan (uneven cooking) vs cooling fan (quiet whirring, controls getting hot). Let me know what you find.
its a quiet steady whirr and warm air is coming out of the slot above the door. no grinding or burning smell. oven itself is still warm, display just shows the clock
Then no repair is needed. If it ever does it in a way that does not fit that, get back in touch and we will look further.
